answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it ebbs each epoch like an outgoing tide unless fed fresh honest work. A fake farm can gleam like an opal for a moment, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing, its trellis of borrowed trust rotting away. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts productively busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent bill.
